title: English Practice Quiz 0891
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: An SOP explains ___.
options: how a task should be performed consistently
how to arrange a social event
questions.explanation: how a task should be performed consistently is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A document marked confidential should be ___.
options: stored and shared only through authorised channels
questions.explanation: stored and shared only through authorised channels is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A document version number helps identify ___.
questions.explanation: which revision is being used is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: If a mandatory field is blank, staff should ___.
options: request the missing information before processing
questions.explanation: request the missing information before processing is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A retention schedule specifies ___.
options: how long records are kept and what happens afterwards
questions.explanation: how long records are kept and what happens afterwards is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A signed acknowledgement usually confirms ___.
options: receipt of a document or item
questions.explanation: receipt of a document or item is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: An audit trail helps show ___.
questions.explanation: who made changes and when is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A document template provides ___.
options: a consistent structure for similar documents
questions.explanation: a consistent structure for similar documents is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A scanned document should be checked for ___.
questions.explanation: readability and completeness is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A correction to an original record should be ___.
questions.explanation: traceable under the record-control procedure is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.
